notes.title: TV Anime GNOSIA - Main Production Staff and 5 Voice Cast Members Revealed!
notes.content:

GNOSIA is currently participating in the Steam Spring Sale with a 30% OFF discount. Now's your chance to play the original if you haven't yet before the anime starts!

notes.title: Provisional Fix for Gnosia Display Bug
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Regarding the bug preventing some character images from displaying properly on certain operating systems, we have uploaded a closed beta build for the version of the game currently available.

Branch: closed_beta
Password: 68387392gnocb

If you are unable to play the game due to display errors, please try switching to the "closed_beta" branch.

[b][How to change branches][/b]
1: Open Properties for Gnosia from your Steam Library.
2: Input the above-listed password into the beta text input field and press "Check Code". 
3: Select "closed_beta" from the Beta tab and close Properties.

This should solve the problem for most users who have encountered said errors. If you still experience bugs or other errors, please report them on the bug report thread. Thank you very much for your patience and cooperation.

notes.title: Gnosia Now Available on PC!
notes.content:
Dear Users,

After a lot of fine-tuning and optimizations, the critically-acclaimed Gnosia has made its long-awaited debut on PC.
Original Steam trading cards are also available to mark this special occasion!

The Gnosia lie. Pretending to be human, they’ll get in close, trick and deceive, and then eliminate one victim at a time... This is a “Werewolf-style” indie game in which you progress through the story by playing through approximately 15-minute rounds (“Loops”), and it has already garnered overwhelmingly positive feedback here in Japan.

notes.content:

The award-winning, highly-reviewed masterpiece is finally coming to Steam!

Initially released for the PS Vita and Nintendo Switch in 2019 and 2020 respectively, Gnosia gained immense popularity locally, resulting in the global release of its English version on Nintendo Switch in March 2021. And now, players will be able to enjoy this critically acclaimed social deduction RPG on Steam.
